svg.title: Many functions satisfy one differential equation
svg.desc: Five curves y = x + 1 + Ce^x for C = −1, −0.5, 0, 0.5 and 1 on −3 ≤ x ≤ 2. The C = 0 curve is the line y = x + 1, drawn in crimson. At x = 0.5 each curve carries a short black segment whose slope is y − 0.5, the value of y − x there, showing that every curve satisfies dy/dx = y − x.
svg.text: black segments at x = 0.5: slope y − x = y − 0.5
